title: Journal app with saved entries and an AI summary
prompt: I want a small journal app for myself. I write an entry in a text box and save it, and it shows up in a list below with the date and time, newest first. When I close the page and come back later my entries have to still be there, so they need to really be saved, not just kept in the page. I should be able to delete an entry and it should stay deleted when I come back. Blank entries shouldn't save. There should also be a Summarize button that sends all my entries to an AI pipeline and shows me a short summary of what I've written. It has to be a real AI answer based on what I actually wrote, so if I add a new entry and summarize again the summary should reflect it. While it's working show that it's working, and if it fails show me an error instead of nothing. If there are no entries the button should just tell me there's nothing to summarize. I have an Anthropic key set up already, so use that for the AI part. Make it and get it working.
